rows.what: What the builder hands the engine (gap: seriesId); seen in 1 of 15 fixture situations: recorded loan with a series and a due day
rows.reason: A debt now says which regular payment covers it, so the same payment is not counted a second time.

rows.what: Demo account: usual money left each month (Debts screen "left", Lines breakdown result)
rows.reason: The new usual month does not subtract saving that was only logged as lines (the old path subtracted 900.00 of logged saving and investing). Saving counts only when it is a standing plan (a repeating series).

rows.what: Demo account: saving row and default floors
rows.reason: Same cause: hand-logged saving no longer counts; only standing saving plans do, and the demo account has none.

rows.what: Demo account: "Met" badges and unset floors for investing and saving
rows.reason: The badge and an unset floor now read standing plans only. A rule with a figure of its own, and logged-only saving, can flip from "Met" to "Not yet".

rows.what: Typed estimates only (income 4,000.00, spending 3,000.00, saving 200.00): usual money left each month
rows.reason: Typed saving, debt and investing figures now count; the old rough path ignored them.

rows.what: Typed estimates only (same account): saving row
rows.reason: Typed saving now shows as the saving row; the old rough path showed none.

rows.what: Any logged month: usual pay (income) on the Grow lines
rows.reason: Decide and Grow now read one usual-month income (typicalIncome). Equal on the fixtures; it can differ for a variable earner. Rounding: none, this is a different statistic, not a rounding step.

rows.what: Household with no debts and no saving; goal plus a 200.00 saving series: income, spending, saving, set-aside, left
rows.reason: Listed so the owner sees the cases that did not move: income, spending and left are identical to the old path on these fixtures.

rows.what: Weekly bills and pay: the gap between payments that is offered as a weekly series
rows.reason: Decide and Activity now share one detector and Activity's windows win; gaps of exactly 5 or 9 days are no longer offered as weekly.

rows.what: Fortnightly bills and pay: the gap offered as fortnightly
rows.reason: Activity's windows win; gaps of 11 or 17 days are no longer offered. This includes a pay on the 3rd and 17th seen in only two months.

rows.what: Monthly bills and pay: the gap offered as monthly
rows.reason: Activity's window starts a day earlier, so a 27-day gap is now offered as monthly (also in two-date clusters).

rows.what: Quarterly bills: the gap offered as quarterly
rows.reason: Activity's window runs two days longer, so gaps of 96 or 97 days are now offered.

rows.what: Yearly bills: the gap offered as yearly
rows.reason: No change; listed so the owner sees every cadence. Minimum repeats and the 10 percent amount tolerance were already identical.
